Description: The 1099 Review report is designed to help you audit your vendor 1099 information. The report can help you determine if any required 1099 information is missing in addition to allowing you to review payment amounts and dates.
This report will provide details pertaining to residents and their BAH rates, in order to participate in the 5% give back program.
This report is very similar to our standard Trial Balance report but displays two additional columns to show which Child Tree accounts are mapped to the Master Accounts.
This report will show when Resident Account Verification detects an invalid account number and prevents a resident from making an echeck payment on the Resident Portal.
This report provides the purchase order details of each accrual journal entry for the period selected.
The Activity Log report will show the activity of a resident/lead, as shown in their Activity Log, over a given period of time.
Product Requirement: Entrata Core, LeaseExecution, LeadManager, Entrata Affordable, Entrata Commercial

Description: The Migrations Activity Log Transfer Report is an internal report that can help you in validating activity logs transfers and imports. This report will be used when migrating sites into entrata that include either a PDM Tool transfer or an activity csv import.

This report will allow you to track and manage your add ons (rentable items, assignable items, and services) by reporting summary occupancy statuses and showing individual add-on item details. Currently, no required permissions are need to use this report.

The Allocations report details how resident receipts and other credits/concessions are allocated against charges and delinquencies. This information is useful for ensuring the appropriate accounting of all collections and analyzing overall collections.

This report will provide a detailed view of property, floor plan, and unit space amenity rent types that have been created within the selected properties. This report also allows you to view which residents and/or prospects that are associated to each amenity rent type listed. Currently, only clients that have Entrata Core can use this report.
This report shows information regarding the reservation of reservable (property-level) amenities and should match what is found under Residents >> Communities >> Reservations.

The Annual Recertifications report provides you with a list of all HUD tenants that are nearing or going through the Annual Recertification process by showing you the progress of any notices sent and tenant response dates. This report requires the use of the Entrata Affordable product.
The Answered Call Distribution report shows the breakdown of calls taken by the Leasing Center in comparison to the  onsite staff. Must have Leasing Center to run report.

The AP Aging report lists all open vendor invoices and organizes the invoice balances according to the number of days the invoice is outstanding. This report is useful for analyzing the aging of the accounts payable balance. The AP Aging report details the accounts payable subsidiary ledger.
The AP Payment Register allows you to review payments that have been made along with the invoices and vendors that are associated to those payments.
AP Payment Register (Consolidate By)

The Application Abandon Points report will show real-time abandoned points for applications started in within the period selected. It will help properties to target two main goals: identify stopping points in the application and help identify leads that may need follow-up.

This report gives a high level summary of various statuses of leads/applicants who have gone through the application process starting from guest card created to lease approved. Currently all clients (core and integrated) can use this report. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Application Detail report displays details for each application in the selected period filter. Because it is based on application and not applicants only the primary applicant name will show. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Application Progress Summary Report will track how well leads are progressing through the application process and will help you to identify whether the progress is made in-office or online. The report bases its metrics on the number of started applications. This means that Started Applications will equal Abandoned Applications plus Lost Applications plus Completed Applications.No product requirements are necessary to use this report.

This report is only available to Entrata Users. It is not intended for client use. The report will provide detailed information on applications. Dates for each status change will be noted. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
The AR Bank Deposit Allocations report allows you to see a list of AR bank deposits broken down by the different charge code allocations.

The AR Bank Deposits report provides a list of AR bank deposits made during the selected period. The report is summarized by default but can be filtered to display detailed information for each deposit.
AR Details
The AR Ledger Details report shows the Ledger details from accounts receivable.
The Asset Tracking report allows you to track both the location and the condition of your company/property assets.
The Asset Valuation report allows you to track information about the company/property physical assets, including location and condition.

This report provides a listing of units that are currently available to be leased to potential residents. This report should be beneficial to leasing agents (on a daily basis) to allow them to identify available units when meeting with leads or existing households looking to transfer. Currently, all clients (core and integrated) can use this report. For larger texts on PDF downloads please remove disabled columns.
The purpose of this report is to see a snapshot of leads signed up for availability alerts, the floor plan they signed up for, and the dates they are scheduled to receive the emails for.

The Balance Sheet report is a financial statement used by investors and owners to help them understand what their company owns, what their company owes, and what has been invested. The Balance Sheet lists a company's assets, liabilities, and equity at a particular point in time, detailing the balance of income and expenditure over the preceding period.
The Balance Sheet by Property report mimics the traditional Balance Sheet report but allows you to see GL account balances broken down by property.

The Balance Sheet Report displays the account balances for balance sheet accounts, as of the end of the user defined post month.  The report summarizes the assets, liabilities, and equity of an organization with the ability to report in a trailing format.
Bank Accounts
The Bank Reconciliation report provides an overview of completed bank reconciliations.

The Bank Register report allows you to see all cash transactions for a property. Using the filters, you can select which bank accounts & transaction types (AR Deposits, Vendor Payments, or Journal Entries) you want to view for the selected period.
The Batch Processing report provides details into resident payments that have been processed within Entrata.
The Billbacks report displays all billback type Due To/Due From transactions that have been processed for the user-defined period.
The Billing Account Invoice Details report will show detailed accounts of invoices received during a period for each account.
The Billing Account Invoices report will show the invoices received during a period for each account or property.
Billing Accounts Aging Report
The purpose of this report is to show if a resident is opted in to receive emailed or mailed utility invoices.

The Box Score provides key property performance data points pertaining to unit availability, lease activity, lead traffic, and make readies. Please note that when tying the report numbers out to other reports the Lead Activity and Lead Conversion datasets are based on activity performed in the period. The report excludes Other Income profiles.
This report is to insert pre-aggregated data into newly created tables.
This report only gives prior month data which will be pre-aggregated.
The Budget report displays the budgeted amounts for each GL Account in each period of the selected budget(s).
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Budget by Property report gives users budget figures for multiple properties in a by property format.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: This report is designed to help clients create a budget for the next year. It combines aspects of the Income Statement Budget vs Actual and the Budget report along with other additions like per unit budget.Â
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Buildings and Units report will provide you with a detailed listing of Buildings and Units to ensure that each are appropriately set up within Entrata. This is a report that would best be used after migration and before the client uses Entrata for leasing, again to ensure all setup was completed appropriately and accurately. Currently, there are no required permissions to use this report.
Shows summary data from the Monthly Reconciliation Report with multiple properties at the same time.  Also included are variance errors.
The purpose of this report is to allow managers to see their progress that their properties have made in regards to the BUA, and allow them to see it for each different lease term.
A report to show an overview of call cap information for those with Leasing Center Contracts and their current call volume.

The Call Center Maintenance Calls report shows the count of maintenance related calls received by the leasing center. The report has two sections. The Call Center Maintenance Calls section displays a count by type; maintenance calls, maintenance emergency calls, work orders. The Calls by Hour section displays all calls received by hour of the day and includes a total call count.

The Call Distribution report helps you analyze the distribution of your calls; when they came in (by day and hour), what type of caller it was, whether it was answered or missed, and more. For those using the Leasing Center product, extra datasets are available to analyze its effectiveness.
The Call Pathway report shows where calls are ending both answered and unanswered. The report shows the path the call has taken from greeting to leasing center.
The Call Performance Report shows the ranking and performance of agents and properties how they compare to against the rest of the portfolio.  Must have Call Analysis to run this report.
The Call Tracker Calls By Result report shows a break down of what calls have been received within Call Tracker and their results as of the selected time period.

The Call Tracking Summary Report shows you an overview of how many calls you are getting per lead source/vanity number.  The Report will also break down Cost per lead (manually enter your lead source costs in settings) and give a total number of calls received for the month.

This report will show an individual line for each call, the evaluation result of the call (stating if it is elgible to be scored), and the score it received. This report can be grouped by leasing agent or property.

The CallAnalysis Results report will give an overview of the call results from call analysis. It will shows what the Leasing Center graders finished, evaluated and analyzed. (This report is only looking at Call Analysis calls and will not tie out to other call tracker reports.) Must have CallAnalysis to run this report. This report only considers Lead calls
The Call Analysis scorecard report shows the performance of a property based on the score they receive in Call Analysis.Must have Call Analysis product to run this report

This report allows you to see all transactions that are being sent to and back from the Mexican Government (Carvajal) in order to track the transmissions of invoices (charges) and receipts (payments) to and from Carvajal.
The Cash Balance Summary report provides you insight into current cash balances based on current information related to cash deposits, payments in transit, checks written, and outstanding payables.
The Cash Flow Statement details the net change in cash during the user defined period. This report is helpful in analyzing the sources and uses of cash throughout various activities.
The Cash Flow Statement by Property report mimics the traditional Cash Flow Statement report but allows you to see GL account balances broken down by property.
The Cash Position report provides users additional detail to ending cash balances.
The Catalog Items report displays a list of all catalog items along with information and settings related to each catalog item.

This report is to give users the ability to pull the current certification of all residents within the selected Affordable properties.  This would allow users to be able to audit the list to ensure the reports are current and the details of the certifications are proper.

The Charge Adjustment Journal report allows you to see what adjustments have been made to charges within a specific post month in order to reconcile such adjustments and to determine if inappropriate adjustments are being made
This report provides you with the details on the charge code setup for each of your properties.  This is especially helpful when researching or auditing accounting setup.
Product Requirement: Entrata Core, Entrata Affordable, Entrata Commercial

Description: The Chart of Accounts report displays all of the present General Ledger Accounts on a single chart along with other optional information.
The Chats report shows statistics regarding the number of chats received by the property as well as key performance indicators.
The Check21 Batches report will show details regarding batches that are scanned into Entrata. You will be able to view the check images and print a summary of the batches through the report.

The Close Reasons Report provides information on why leads have been cancelled or archived. This information is based on the reason that is selected at the time of cancellation. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
This report will provide greater detail into residents going through the collections process or those who potentially will be in the collections process.
This report provides the user an easy way to see all associated contacts for their tenant
This report consolidates all of their tenant's clauses into one place, allowing you to filter by clause, display the tenant, clause and clause details.

The Commercial Rent Roll report is a version of the standard Rent Roll that is specifically geared towards commercial properties. This report gives you a high-level overview of the rent and transactional impact for all suites and tenants within the property as well as an Occupancy Summary breakdown for each building within the property. Currently, only clients that have access to the Commercial product can use this report.
This report is meant to provide insight to the Accruals journal entry posting.
This report provides a summary view of committed costs by job cost code.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Events report will provide you with a list of all active events that have been created for the selected properties along with various details on each event. Currently, there are no required permissions in order to use this report This report will pull those events that have been created within Residents >> Community >> Events.

This purpose of this report is to compare delinquency across similar periods to find aberrations in data. The report goes through the progression of Charges Due minus Collections yields Delinquency. Additional options are included to show the Balance at the end of the period, and collections and delinquency on Charges Due after the period.

The Comparative Income Statement is an Income Statement that compares a company's current revenues and expenses to those from historical periods through the use of additional columns. By comparing the results from multiple historical periods a company can see how they are performing over time.
The Compliance Summary report shows the compliance level of each vendor a property uses.

The Concessions report shows information regarding leases with at least one transaction from Charge Codes selected in the Concessions filter within the range created by the user selecting a Period and additional Trailing and Future Periods. The report has two sections: Resident Concessions and Concessions Burn-off.
The Consumption Log report provides a list of all inventory consumed during a given date range or post month.

This report will display all the contact forms that have been submitted by residents, and all the information that has been submitted for each contact form. This report will also display contact forms that have been deleted.

This report is only available to Entrata Users. It is not intended for client use ever. We need to keep the report clean as it is used for the majority of Drill ins. The report will provide data for drill-in on all other Contact Point reports.

The Contact Point Analysis report helps gauge how well the property and leasing agents are at responding to leads that need follow-up. The Lead Manager Product is required to run this report. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
The Contract Summary report gives users a summary of contract amounts, expenses, and retention organized by contract, grouped by job cost code.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: For clients using convenience fee clearing, the Convenience Fee Clearing Report will show details concerning the billing for resident payments. It will list the resident's convenience fee, the management fee, and the net fee as well as settlement information.

The purpose of this report is to display highest conversion pathways and give marketers more insight as to how they may want to allocate future marketing spend across lead sources. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
The Corporate Billing report is designed to show invoice details for screenings of Corporate Leads in a given month.
The Job Cost Codes report gives Job Costing users the ability to see cost code set up in a report format.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Courses report will show which employees have completed, failed, or failed to complete training courses that have been assigned.

The Craiglist Ad Activity Report will show how many ads are being posted to Craigslist and how many website visits result from the ads. It can be summarized by property, leasing agent, month, or floorplan.
The Craigslist Posting Performance Report will show the number of ads that are posted and the average time it took to create and post the ad.
This Custom Tags report displays all AP, AR and JE activity by custom tag.
This report will allow users to see an aged view of all of their inter-company receivables in order to more easily follow-up with entities that owe them money.
The Customer Invoices report will support the AR functionality for properties to generate customer invoices for their residents / customers.
This report will overview key aspects of the daily on-site activities. Datasets include Summary, Lead Sources, Leasing Agents, Move-out Reasons, and Close Reasons.
Pulls specific fields of the dashboard audit report, created to be pulled via an API without the increased server load

The Dashboard Audit Report report will give you a high-level view of how many items and tasks you have on your dashboard that are still opened or pending. This report is broken out based on each selected Dashboard tab and its corresponding sub-tabs.

The Deferred Revenue report allows you to see what the total recurring billings will be over the life of the listed residents active lease term with the ability to compare how much of that total contract has been billed (to date) and how much of that total contract is remaining to be billed.

This report will allow you to view reviews that have been deleted and see who and when they were deleted within a selected date range. Currently, only clients that have the Reputation Advisor product can use this report.
This report will allow you to view details on households who have delinquent, unpaid balances allowing you to identify residents who may need notices sent or perhaps eviction processes initiated.

The Demand report shows the popularity and demand for units based on: Age, Bedroom Count, Gender, Occupant Count, and Rental Rate. The data is collected from prospect guest cards and applications.
This report is not restricted by products used.
The Deployment report allows you to track service members that are deployed or on active military duty away from their home.
This report will display Residents insured under Deposit Alternative.

This report provides users with a list of past residents in order to see how their deposits were allocated and refunded. This enables the sites to have an audit style report to ensure the deposit was fully allocated and towards what.
The purpose of this report is to provide organized details concerning payments that have been disassociated and then re-associated
The Disassociated Payments report shows payments that have been disassociated from residents and shows the new association if one has been made.
The DocStorage Document Activity report shows how many documents have been uploaded or downloaded in a specific date range.  Must have DocManagement to use this report.
The DocStorage Usage report shows when and how many documents were synced as well as uploads and downloads.  Must have DocManagement to use this product.
The Donation Settlement Report will show details regarding settlements of payments applied to a charity.
The Draw Request Details report lists every Job Cost invoice or JE transaction associated to a Draw Request in the Job Costing module.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Electronic Payment Summary report shows the total amount of transactions for each electronic payment type as well as the payment volume for these transactions for each property.
A report to show conversion and determine how well the Entrata Redd Chatbot is performing.
A report to show conversion and determine how well the Entrata Redd Voice is performing.
This is an internal report used by the Entrata Reporting team.  This report is NOT to be distributed to clients or shown to clients.
The Expense Distribution report provides a listing of all expenses posted to the general ledger from accounts payable during the user defined period.

The Expiring Leases report displays a list of leases which have or will expire in the user-defined period.  This data allows the property to prepare for upcoming unit turnovers or initiate the renewal process with such households.
This report is designed to give users an idea of when their vendor's insurance policies are going to be expiring.

The Failed Recurring Payments report shows what recurring payments failed and what the failure reason was for those payments. This is helpful because by seeing what recurring payments failed the client can prevent their residents paying late fees the resident wasn't responsible for
The Failed System Emails report will show which emails have failed to be sent.

With each state having legal requirements to provide residents/applicants within a certain time-frame, this report will provide regional and corporate users the ability to audit what needs to be done in the FMO process in order to get these refunds out on time.

The Forecast Income Statement displays expected performance for the budget period. The report lists actual results for periods that have occurred, and budgeted results for future periods. Combined, these values represent a forecast for the total budget period.

The Forecasted Occupancy report will provide average occupancy percentages on a monthly outlook, allowing you to forecast occupancy within the properties that have been selected. Currently all clients (core and integrated) can view this report.
The Future Recurring Work Orders report displays all recurring work order templates that are scheduled to be generated within the selected period.
This report lists all GL Accounts that are associated to the user defined property/property group.

Report: GL Account Totals by Property: Balance Sheet
Description: This drill down report displays GL account totals by property when the Balance Sheet is consolidated.

Report: GL Account Totals by Property: Income Statement
Description: This drill down report displays GL account totals by property when the Income Statement is consolidated.

Report: GL Account Totals by Property: Income Statement Budget vs Actual
Description: This drill down report displays GL account totals by property when the Income Statement - Budget vs Actual is consolidated.

The GL Details report allows you to look at the details of every transaction that is recorded to your general ledger. Using the filters you can select which GL accounts you want to see the details for over a selected period. This report is helpful for analyzing account balances and the specific transactions included in those account balance.
This report provides a list of all GL Export Batches for a property or properties.
Provides a snapshot, by property, of the totals for any element within the tree including, GL accounts, GL Account Groups, or Total Groups.

The Gross Potential Rent (GPR) report is used to determine the maximum rent that a property could receive based off of market rent prices if all of their units were rented.  This report shows that number as well as what is preventing the property from reaching that number. (e.g. vacancy).

The Gross Potential Rent (GPR) - Cash Basis report is used to determine the maximum rent that a property could receive based off of market rent prices if all of their units were rented. This report shows that number as well as what is preventing the property from reaching that number. (e.g. vacancy).
The Cash Basis version of this report breaks out how the system calculates the GPR journal entry when it is set to Cash.  It includes cash receipts and change in delinquency for the period.
The Group Leasing report allows users to view Groups and Contracts on selected properties, as well as view the residents that are associated to those contracts.

This report allows you to audit group permissions and access levels, (read only, deny, and allow).
Note: There are over 2,500 permissions available in the system, which is a lot of data when running it for all groups. Below are some tips and tricks to running this report.
1. We suggest that you do not run this report by generating it in the Entrata System. Instead, we ask that you download it as an XLS, PDF, or CSV. 
2. Because of the large amount of data, we do not allow you to consolidate all groups onto one page. This helps increase the report generation time and decreases the chance of the browser crashing.
3. When running this report in the E and selecting all groups, your browser may crash. To avoid that see item #1.
The Guest Check-Ins report provides a list of all resident guests who visited a property in the user-defined period.
This report will display all the historic rent values (for a selected date range) by unit, unit type, and property.

This report allows you to quickly review the changes to your Base, Amenity, Special, Add On and ultimately Market Rents on your Units and Spaces.  This report is directly related to the Historial Rents (Rate Logs) information found within Setup.
This report will allow you to view all documents that have been added to the 'Documents' tab of the Resident/Lead and if they are visible in Resident Portal.
This report will allow you to report on prospects or residents who need to upload their ID or have their ID-verified.

This report is to show when units went into an 'in service' (excluded) status, and when they went back into a 'rentable' status on a quarterly basis. This is a Military report that is part of the Schedule G reporting packet.
The Inactive Users report will give you a list of all users that have been flagged as inactive.

The Income Statement, also known as a Profit and Loss Statement or simply a P&L, is a financial statement that shows revenue and expenses over a specified period of time. The Income Statement helps companies measure their financial performance over the given period by outlining the revenues and expenses and calculating a net income or loss.

The Income Statement Budget v. Actual, is a financial statement that shows a company's revenue and expenses over a specified period of time. This report will provide a comparison of actual revenues and expenses to what's been budgeted for the period, and provide a variance.
The Income Statement by Property report mimics the traditional Income Statement report but allows you to see GL account balances broken down by property.

The Income Statement by Unit summarizes the revenues and expenses by Floor Plan, Unit Type, Bldg., or Unit  for a given period.  The report is useful for analyzing profitability at a Building or Unit level.
This report allows Affordable (HUD) projects to effectively manage their Section 8 contracts by enabling users to see the Income Levels of their residents.
The Inspection Manager Details report will provide details for each inspection through the Inspection Manager product.
The Inspection Summary report will show a summary of failed inspections through the Inspection Manager product.
This report gives Inspection Manager users a count of all inspections created for each inspection template, along with a breakdown of those inspections and their current status.

The Installments by Lease report provides a list of leases assigned to installment plans.  This allows you to verify the setup of installment plans associated to leases.  This includes data such as lease term, installment plan name, and a list of each installment.
This report will provide a breakdown of total residents that are insured, who is uninsured, and who their policy is currently with and will group this data by policy status

The Insurance Policy Details report provides you with details on the insurance policies that the residents within your properties carry. Currently, there are no required permissions to use this report.
Product Requirement: Entrata Core, Renters Insurance, Entrata PaaS

Description: Description not added yet.
Integration Queues
Integration Residents
Integration Results
Integration Service Logs

This report will allow inter-company users to see how many reimbursement invoices are owed to the parent property/bank account owner at any given time. This will allow for better cash management and planning.

The goal of this report is to show users what transactions make up their inter-company GL accounts. The total or ending balance for each of the 3 sections in this report should tie out to the corresponding GL account.
The Inventory Quantities report allows you to see how much inventory the company/property has, where it's stored, and how much you have on order.
This report provides the details of inventory transfers that occur between asset locations & properties
The Inventory Valuation report allows you to see the total value of the inventory the company/property owns based on location, property, and category.

The Invoice Approval History report tracks when invoices that used approval routing were approved and who approved them. This lets you see how long it takes an item to move through the approval process.
This report shows details of all the taxes and charges associated to each invoice created and is used for auditing purposes and as an export for important government tax documents.

The report will show the IVRs a company uses and show the performance of each option and sub option. The report shows where calls are being connected through as well as where callers are abandoning the call.
This report provides a summary view of actual and budget amounts for job categories by property.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Job Cost - Budget vs Actual report allows you to compare actual job costs to budgeted job costs by cost category.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Job Cost Details report lists transaction details for Jobs that are being managed through the Job Costing product. Using the filters, you can select which Jobs, Phases, and Job Cost Codes you want displayed in the report.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: This report allows you to view user defined categories or cost codes summarized into a single line item, while viewing other's in full detail over the entire history of the job.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: This report gives the user a quick overview of how a job is doing financially. At a glance, the user can see how much has been budgeted, contracted, and paid (invoiced) for each job cost code.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Job Costing Budget Revision report provides an audit trail history of the budget for a job readily accessible, in context, for job costing users.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: This report used for download job listing from job costing in pdf/excel/CSV format.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: This report will allow Job Costing users to see a quick overview of all Jobs associated to a specific property. The report will highlight pertinent info like Budget, Actual, Cost to Complete, etc. by job.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Journal Entry Register allows you to audit and research any journal entries created during the selected reporting period.

This report will display all late fee batches that were posted during the selected period/date range showing the household and fee amounts. This will enable you to review all such late fee postings to ensure all appropriate fees were posted and processed accordingly.

This report provides a list of residents who have overdue balances showing the dates in which late notices were sent to them and basic information on their overdue balance.  This enables the user to track those households in order to manage when to send additional notices or when to initiate the eviction process.

The Lead Conversion report will help you to understand how well you are moving leads through the leasing process and converting them into leases. Key metrics that are used include: new leads, started applications, completed applications, dead leads, signed leases, and move-ins. Duplicate Leads, leads that are cancelled with a merged or cloned reason, will not be included on the report. There are no product required for this report. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
The Lead Score Analysis report will give users a high level overview of how accurate the generated lead score has been.
The purpose of the Lead Score Details Report is to view information pertaining to the scoring of each individual lead. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Lead Source Attribution Report allows you to analyze the expenditure and rate of return for leads and leases based on each lead source.The Entrata Core product is required for this report. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Lead Source Details Report will show a list of active lead sources, the associated vanity number, forwarding number, email tracker address, and switch codes. Properties can use this to audit their lead source setup. No product requirements are necessary for this report.

This report is designed to combine the Leads by Property, Leads By Lead Source, and Leads By Product reports. The report shows the number of new leads over a selected period of time, grouped by Property, Lead Source, or Product. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Lead Trends by Source report shows the lead count for each source based off the lead source that was selected on the guest card. The data is separated by month so that you can view the change over the period selected. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
The Leads By Lead Source Report will show the traffic volume of each lead source and will allow you to compare traffic volume across the board. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

This report will provide you with a list of households based on specific key lease activity metrics such as move-ins, move-outs, renewals, etc. This allows you to identify those households who have fallen into any of these key buckets, allowing you to more effectively track those households or confirm the action taken for each household. Currently, all clients (core and integrated) can use this report.

This report will give a summary of residents who have their leases approved, completed, renewals, or who have moved-in to the selected properties, as well as provide information on the leasing agent that is responsible for each of these residents. Currently, all clients (core and integrated) can use this report.

This report will provide detailed lease information at the resident level for the property(ies) selected. This report will display lease start/end dates, move-in/move-out dates, as well as deposit and scheduled rent charges. Currently, core clients and integrated clients can use this report.
The purpose of the Lease Execution Adoption Report is to track how well properties are doing at converting to paperless lease signing procedures. Report excludes Other Income profiles.
The purpose of the Lease Execution (Applicant) report is to be able to track lease signatures based on applicant types.

The Lease Execution Summary Application Report display the progress of applications through the leasing process. For those using the Independent Lease Progression setting please use the Lease Execution Summary Applicant Report. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Lease Term Progress Summary report provides both a snapshot of where leads are in the leasing process (Leads In Status) and how much time leads are taking in each step of the leasing process (Days In Status).

The purpose of the Lease Trade-out report is to show all lease trade-outs for a given period. The report allows the user to see how much money is being gained or lost between leases for a specific unit.
Lease Trade-out - Insert Data
Lease Trade-out - Prior Month

The Leases with Multiple Recurring Payments report will list all recurring payments that are on the same lease. This report will help to ensure that residents do not have more than one recurring payment set up and that residents with more than one lease payee are not overpaying.
The Leases with Multiple Rent charges report shows which resident were double billed rent for the post month selected.
The Leases without Rent Charges reports shows you how many leases were not charged rent for that post month.

This report will allow you to view move-in/move-out activity of military residents based on their pay grades, and see the total net move-in count for selected date range. Currently, only clients that have access to the military product can use this report.

This usage of the Pricing Audit report varies depending on what view you're looking at: The Variance view shows what the leasing agents are actually getting for the unit. The Acceptance view gives you an inside view on what the Entrata Pricing tool is suggesting the price be for specific units and what is actually being posted. This view shows the frequency of price changes from what the tool recommends. Not only is this view beneficial for your use, but it also allows for Entrata to see if any settings need to be adjusted in order to get the prices more to what you are wanting.

The Unit Exclusions report provides you with a list of all units that are flagged as excluded along with the exclusion reason and the starting and ending dates of when the unit was flagged.

The Unit Expenses report lists expenses by unit, to help give you insight into what's been spent for a given unit over a selected period of time. The transactions listed will be pulled from invoices and journal entries where a line item has been associated to a unit.

The Unit Maintenance Alert report provides you with information regarding the quantity of maintenance requests/items for a specific unit during specified time frame.  The report is useful for identifying units with an abnormal volume of maintenance needs.
The Unit Maintenance Expense report displays the total labor, mileage, and material costs by work order for each unit over a period of time.

The Unit Space Data report will list all the units/unit spaces for the property/properties selected, and will display data relating to each unit space (current resident, vacancy date, lease dates, deposits, scheduled rent, etc.). Currently, all clients (core and integrated) can use this report.
This report will display rent rates for each unit type and for every active lease term that is associated with the property(ies) selected.
The Unsettled Payments report shows details regarding payments that have not settled into the bank account.
Through this report you can easily bulk audit user login history

The User Permissions Change Log report allows you to view a list of all changes made to a user or group permissions/assignments during a specified period of time and who made the change.  This will capture any changes made to Setup >> Users & Groups.
The Users and Groups Report report will list all Users and Groups within the company and their various permissions and assignments that have been configured.
This report will allow you to see the expense and consumption rank for properties
The Utility Bill report will list the utility bills for your properties.
The Utility Bill Audits report shows the details of utility audits that have occurred.
This report will take the expense or consumption for a property and break it out by month so that I can see the data I need to give to an energy broker to procure energy.
The Unit Licenses report enables you to see which licenses have been stored on a unit. All units are shown in the report, as well as the licenses, residents, and applicants assigned to the unit.
This report will allow you to compare properties expense and consumption
The UtilityTrend report shows the trends of each utility account over a period of time.
This report will display the trending consumption and expense for utility commodities.
The Vacant Unit Cost Management (VCM) shows a quick view of what the high costs and potential leaks per vacant unit.
The VCR Only Recovery report shows you a detailed list of what your vacant cost recovery is by unit and resident.
The VCR Portfolio Performance report gives a you a view of how your portfolio does with vacant cost recovery.
The VCR Recovery report shows you a detailed list of what your vacant cost recovery is by unit and resident.

The VendorAccess Utilization report provides an overview of utilization of the VendorAccess tool across your vendors. It'll display the number missing information like Tax ID's, which have been invited to sign up, and what locations have been mapped.

The purpose of this report is to provide clients with a place they can view Vendor Hopper Numbers without having to go into each vendor individually. This report can be downloaded and used to fill out form letters.
This report gives our Job Costing users the ability to see cost code totals, with a breakdown by vendor for each code.
Associated Product: Asset Operations - Budgeting and Job Costing

Description: The Vendor Details report displays general information about vendors.
The Vendor Exemptions report shows which vendors are exempt from vendor compliance rules, and gives details on why they are exempt.
The Vendor Insurance report displays insurance policy information by vendor. The report is useful for reviewing vendor insurance policy information such as policy expiration and limit amounts.

The Vendor Invoice Details report provides summary or line item invoice information based on several user inputs such as vendor, date, and posting status.  The report is helpful for reviewing high level invoice information, as well as the GL account to which each invoice line item is booked.

The Vendor Ledger Report provides you with details on vendor invoice and payment transactions by vendor. The report is useful for viewing transaction history by vendor and determining vendor balances.
This report will allow non-Entrata Core users to view vendor ledger activity.
This report provides a summary view of monthly invoice amounts by vendor. This report can be useful in determining trends and catching anomalies.
This report lists vendor activity summarized by month for non-Entrata Core users.
This report shows a summary of the type and amount of resident violations that occur at a property. The detail view will give insight into violations for the period selected.
The Wait List report allows you to download/print your applicant wait lists. This report ties directly into the Leads >> Tools >> View Wait List tool.

The Warranty Tracking report allows you to quickly see warranty information for all of the company/property assets broken down by category or property. It is especially useful for tracking expiration dates.
Web Service Logs

The Weekly Performance Report is a high level report that will show a count of new leads, the type of first contact, and if a manual contact has been attempted on each of these leads. The detail view will show each lead listed on a separate line with each of the performed events listed. Report excludes Other Income profiles.

The Work Order Details report allows you to view various details on work orders in order to see the total days the work order was opened, the total cost of the work order as well as average days and cost of each work order. This will enable you to track trends on how long it takes work orders to be completed and their associated costs based on the property, work order category, assigned maintenance staff and individual problem.
The Work Order Labor report provides you with all labor charges from work orders for a user-defined property and period.
The Work Order Mileage report allows you to see how much mileage has been logged per work order.

The Work Order Origin Report allows properties to measure the number of work orders that are submitted through each source. Sources include: Entrata, Resident Portal, Integration, Mobile Portal, Site Tablet, Leasing Center, and Inspection Manager.

The Work Order Performance report is a military report that looks at how many work orders were received in a given period and what the response rate was and the completion rate. The report is also looking at the total work orders carried over from the last period.
The Work Order Satisfaction report will show the results of the work order surveys that are sent out to residents who recently had a work order completed.
This report displays all surveys sent to residents after a work order has been completed, and provides pertinent details about the WO and residents.
Work Order Summary Report will give you a high level summary of work orders opened, canceled, completed, and pending within a defined period of time.

This report will show information regarding write-off recovery activity in the chosen period of time.  This will allow clients to determine how much has been recovered and when for commision purposes if collections are done internally.
This report displays the Year to Date actual amounts along with the remaining amount forecasted for the period selected.
